differences.native: LeetCode calls firstBadVersion(n) and supplies the global isBadVersion(version) predicate.
differences.app: solve(n, bad) receives the authored JSON boundary and defines isBadVersion(version) as version >= bad.
differences.rationale: The offline runner must expose the hidden boundary as explicit deterministic case data. After this one-line environment adapter, both artifacts execute the same boundary-preserving binary search and make the same number of predicate calls.
